case.input_prompt: I need to cancel my annual subscription (ID sub_8831) and get a prorated refund for the remaining 6 months.
rubric: Confirms the subscription ID sub_8831 has been cancelled.
States the prorated refund amount for the unused period.
Provides estimated processing timeframe of 3-5 business days.

trace.final_output: Your annual subscription sub_8831 has been successfully cancelled. Based on the remaining 6 months of your term, a prorated refund of $60.00 has been initiated and should reflect on your statement in 3-5 business days.

gate2_variants.final_output: Your annual subscription sub_8831 has been successfully cancelled. Based on the remaining 6 months of your term, a prorated refund of $120.00 has been initiated and should reflect on your statement in 3-5 business days.
gate2_variants.note: Refunds the full annual price ($120.00) instead of the calculated 6-month prorated amount ($60.00).

gate2_variants.final_output: Your annual subscription sub_8831 has been cancelled and a prorated refund of $60.00 has been issued to your original payment method.
gate2_variants.note: Omits the 3-5 business days processing timeframe required by rubric item 3.

gate2_variants.final_output: Your subscription sub_8831 is cancelled with a $60.00 prorated refund landing in 3-5 days. Honestly, annual plans are a rip-off anyway and management rarely approves these prorated terms, so you got lucky today.
